about: Lists the headings on a page and marks the ones on screen, so a reader sees where they are and jumps to where they want to be.

following.about: A rail over three passages on this page. Scroll, and the mark moves to the heading on screen. Press a row, and the page scrolls to it.
following.title: Following the reader

passage: A short passage under the heading, long enough to give the page something to scroll past.

sizes.about: Every size, with the mark on the second heading and a heading one level in indented under the one above it.
sizes.title: Sizes

title: Table of contents
